# Price tables are post-run JSON ledgers only.
! exec $CLI -format json -prices prices.json
stderr 'prices require non-streaming cost format without a sink'
! exec $CLI -format cost
stderr 'prices require non-streaming cost format without a sink'
! exec $CLI -format cost -prices prices.json -stream
stderr 'prices require non-streaming cost format without a sink'
! exec $CLI -format cost -prices prices.json -endpoint https://example.com
stderr 'prices require non-streaming cost format without a sink'
exec $CLI -input run.json -format cost -prices prices.json
stdout '"price_sha256":"[0-9a-f]{64}"'
stdout '"total":0'
stdout '"currency":"USD"'
stdout '"schema_version":2'

# A retained response model keys the price; an unpriced alias never borrows
# the requested model's rate.
exec $CLI -input routed.json -format cost -prices prices.json
stdout '"index":0,"model":"m","price_model":"m","price_basis":"requested","amount":0.00004}'
stdout '"index":1,"model":"m","price_model":"m-2026","price_basis":"observed","amount":null,"unavailable":"observed model price missing"'
stdout '"total":null'
